messages:
pagerbot: 🚨 SEV2 alert — 5xx spike on /v1/generate (ingress). Error rate ~13% over last 2m. Paging marta (oncall) and raj (sre). Correlation id sample: c-id=8f3a2b7e

marta (oncall): on it. can anyone pull a quick timeline and customer impact? pinging emily for support/customer calls.

emily (support): I have 2 customers reporting slow responses and errors: AcmeCorp (prod) and Shoply (canary). Acme saw ~12 failed requests in last 5m.

raj (sre): jumping in. first hypothesis: upstream throttle on egress to model-hosting cluster causing request amplification and 502/504s. need traces + request counts per backend. samir, any infra changes in last hour?

samir (runtime): no deploys in last hour from runtime. We did push a kernel-override to a small canary earlier but that was staggered. pulling ingress proxy logs now.

observability-bot: alert context: ingress_rps went +45% at 2134567650, avg latency rose from 140ms -> 700ms, 5xx_count: 420 in 5m window. Top path: /v1/generate. Top upstream: model-hosting-eu-1 cluster.

marta (oncall): ok timeline: spike started ~2134567600 per obsv-bot. can someone grep for correlation ids and attach a few raw logs? include request/response codes, upstream host, and any retry headers.

raj (sre): pasting a condensed log snippet: ```
2134567672 request_id=8f3a2b7e path=/v1/generate upstream=mh-eu-1 code=502 x-retries=3 latency=890ms
2134567674 request_id=91b4cfa2 path=/v1/generate upstream=mh-eu-1 code=504 x-retries=4 latency=1200ms
2134567680 request_id=bb12aa33 path=/v1/generate upstream=mh-eu-2 code=200 x-retries=0 latency=1100ms
```
Patterns: heavy retry headers on 502/504s. looks like client is retrying or gateway is re-sending.

jin (platform): noticed increased 429s from model-hosting-eu-1 about the same time. Could be upstream throttling and gateway retries amplifying. Do we have request-id propagation across hops?

samir (runtime): we do forward x-request-id -> x-correlation-id. grepping for x-retries header shows gateway sets x-retries when it re-enqueues to upstream. gateway config recent?

marta (oncall): mitigation: reduce gateway retry attempts to 0 for /v1/generate temporarily, and fail fast to avoid amplification. Can someone flip that at the edge? Jin?

jin (platform): I can patch the route policy to disable retries for that route. will rollout to edge in 30s canaries then global. doing canary now.

observability-bot: action log: route policy patch submitted by jin at 2134567725. Canary to 2 edge nodes.

raj (sre): while we wait, collect a histogram of upstream response codes by host. attaching quick results: mh-eu-1: 502=320,504=85,200=60; mh-eu-2: 502=5,504=2,200=420. mh-eu-1 is clearly pressured.

emily (support): updating impacted customer list: AcmeCorp (prod) - intermittent 502s, Shoply (canary) - elevated latency. notifying both with current mitigation steps.

marta (oncall): hypothesis list (in-thread): 1) upstream mh-eu-1 overloaded -> returns 502/504. 2) gateway retry policy replays requests -> amplifies load (amplification loop). 3) client retry behavior also contributing. 4) a canary kernel-override may have increased per-request latency and reduced capacity.

samir (runtime): quick KV: canary kernel-override target was mh-eu-2 only, not mh-eu-1. so #4 less likely. however, mh-eu-1 has a recent autoscaler config change last week that reduced burst capacity. worth looking.

jin (platform): canary rollback complete. retries disabled on route for global rollout starting now.

observability-bot: route policy change propagated to 100% at 2134567776. retry_count metric for /v1/generate dropped to ~0 within one minute.

raj (sre): early signal: 5xx rate falling from 13% -> 3% over 2 minutes after policy change. latency still elevated for some requests ~800-900ms. continuing to monitor.

marta (oncall): good. next steps: 1) keep retries disabled for 1 hour while we stabilize. 2) investigate mh-eu-1 autoscaler and throttling 3) gather traces for top-correlation ids and follow upstream logs (attach full traces for 8f3a2b7e, 91b4cfa2). raj/samir to own. emily to keep customers updated.

raj (sre): collecting full trace for 8f3a2b7e: ```
ingress -> gateway (x-retries=3) -> mh-eu-1: 502 gateway receives 502, attempts retry -> mh-eu-1 queue length spikes -> subsequent requests get 504/timeouts.
```
Attaching link to trace viewer: https://obsv.local/traces/8f3a2b7e

samir (runtime): found autoscaler logs with throttled_event at 2134567598 for mh-eu-1: "scaling blocked due to quota: ephemeral-gpu-constraint" - bookmarking. Looks like cluster couldn't scale quickly.

marta (oncall): tagging hypothesis #2 and #1 as likely root contributors: gateway retries + upstream scaling quota. Action owners: raj (retries/rate policy), samir (autoscaler/quota), jin (rollback/policy), emily (customer comms).

emily (support): updated AcmeCorp: "We've disabled automated retries at the gateway and are seeing error rates decrease. Our team will keep you updated while we investigate upstream capacity."

marta (oncall): will keep the channel open for handoff. if error rate stays <1% for 20m, we'll de-escalate. otherwise escalate to infra lead for quota bump.

observability-bot: current metrics snapshot at 2134568110: error_rate=1.8% latency_p50=210ms p95=930ms upstream_mh-eu-1_502=40.

raj (sre): noting followup RCA items in ticket INF-3421: 1) add safety limit to gateway retries to avoid amplification; 2) improve autoscaler quota alerting; 3) correlation-id propagation audit; 4) post-incident test for retry behavior.

marta (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll escalate if the error rate rebounds. closing doc for now but keeping channel pinned to incident until final RCA. :white_check_mark:
